abstract: Choriocarcinoma is a rare disease in pediatric neoplasms. The prognosis of the disease is extremely poor once when patients relapse or become refractory to cisplatin (CDDP). A 17-year-old male who had retroperitoneal pure choriocarcinoma of advanced stage was treated with CDDP-based intensive chemotherapy. In spite of the initial good response to CDDP-based intensive chemotherapy, the tumor metastasized to multiple areas of the brain during chemotherapy. Since the brain in this case was thought to be a sanctuary, after radiotherapy to the whole cranium, the patient was treated with high-dose chemotherapy consisting of etoposide, carboplatin, and ranimustine (MCNU), which can penetrate the blood-brain barrier, followed by autologous bone marrow transplantation (ABMT). Twenty-four months after ABMT, the patient had no sign of disease recurrence. MCNU-containing high-dose chemotherapy with ABMT appears to be quite effective in cases that present with relapsing multiple brain metastases during CDDP-based chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は小児腫瘍のなかでまれな疾患である。再発した場合やシスプラチン(CDDP)に不応となった場合、予後は極めて不良である。進行期の後腹膜純粋絨毛癌を有する17歳男性に、CDDPを基本とする強力化学療法を施行した。CDDPを基本とする強力化学療法に初期に良好な反応を示したが、化学療法中に腫瘍は脳の多発部位に転移した。本症例では脳が「聖域」とみなされたため、全頭蓋への放射線療法の後、血液脳関門を通過しうるエトポシド、カルボプラチン、ranimustine(MCNU)からなる大量化学療法を施行し、その後自家骨髄移植(ABMT)を行った。ABMTの24か月後、再発の兆候は認められなかった。CDDPを基本とする化学療法中に多発脳転移の再発を生じた症例では、MCNUを含む大量化学療法とABMTが極めて有効と思われる。
